# ModelManager

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/renderer/model/`](../folders/src-renderer-model.md)
> **Source:** [`src/renderer/model/model_manager.h`](../../../src/renderer/model/model_manager.h), [`src/renderer/model/model_manager.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/model/model_manager.cpp)

## Summary

Context variable caching loaded models: path (or key) -> entity holding the ModelC.

## Description

Emplaced by the Renderer constructor, so it exists only in rendered runs (the ModelRenderable scene component throws 'ModelRenderable needs the renderer' without it). load(path) returns the cached entity or loads the glTF/GLB file, creating one entity with a ModelC; on failure logs an error and returns entt::null (the entity created before loading is left behind without components). add(key, MeshData) builds a single-material white mesh from code and caches it under key. get(path) only looks up the cache. Paths are used verbatim as cache keys (callers prefix ./resources/). Erased by Renderer::finish.

| `models` | `std::unordered_map<std::string, entt::entity>` | empty | Cache, private. |
